essence: Kula knowledge shines forth for one whose mind is purified as if by mantra.
All who are established in Kula dharma are non-returning.
Kula knowledge shines forth in people whose sins have been exhausted.
Kula knowledge shines forth through devotion to the deity and the guru.
Kula knowledge shines forth for one who is extremely devoted to the secret.
